name: create_tool
description: Save a private callable pure Python expression function. Source must be def name(args): return one_expression. Supports JSON indexing, arithmetic, comparisons, conditionals and pure len/sum/min/max/abs/round/sorted/str/int/float/bool calls. No imports, attributes, loops, filesystem or network. Invoke it with run_soft_ability; this does not grant a new top-level tool permission.
